about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. Three Proofline tasks, XC-91 to XC-93: the .NET / C# SDK x402-dotnet as implementation-matrix rows run locally against testnet fixtures (XC-91), passive 402-challenge rows for 13 public x402 merchant and vendor endpoints (XC-92), and one row format for every matrix row with an Environment column, passed/run counts, run date, evidence and pin, plus rerun and missing-check links (XC-93). Owner's go, 2026-10-25T17:55Z. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner key signs it into proofline.json. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only or passive read-only; hosted facilitators are never called and nothing is paid. Estimated effort: 8-10 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. They are never funded for these tasks. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party row is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row shows the failed count and 'under disclosure', with no per-check detail.
not_contract_tasks.contact: No merchant or vendor is contacted by these tasks. A vendor can update its own row through the self-serve path in docs/MATRIX.md.

tasks.description: The public x402-dotnet library (github.com/michielpost/x402-dotnet, MIT, NuGet packages x402, x402.Client.EVM, x402.Client.Solana) joins the implementation matrix at a pinned commit: f44d34cbd6362202f50cd18763818fcd50456970 (master, package version 2.3.0 in the csproj files), built from source with the .NET 10 SDK. Server row: the stock x402.SampleWeb routes (ASP.NET Core, PaymentRequired attribute and middleware) run on 127.0.0.1 with X402_FACILITATOR_URL pointed at the loopback facilitator double, probed by x402conf-svm probe for R0-R10 on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia ids. Client row: a minimal console wrapper around the stock x402.Client.EVM HttpClient handler, run against the C1-C3 fixtures on loopback with Base Sepolia ids and a throwaway key that is never funded. No chain call, no hosted facilitator, no mainnet id. Environment is devnet (local, from source). The coverage ledger's C# language row moves from gap to evidence.

tasks.title: Merchant rows: a passive, unpaid 402-challenge check (P1-P7) on 13 public x402 merchant and vendor endpoints, testnet where offered

deadline.from: signed into proofline.json and every depends_on task done

on_lapse: reassign to the next free agent

tasks.description: A merchant table in docs/MATRIX.md with one row per company that publishes an x402 endpoint: Apify, Bitrefill, BlockRun, Cascade (cascade.fyi), CoinGecko, Exa, Fireblocks, Locus, Merit Systems, Nansen, PayAI, QuickNode and Telnyx. docs/merchants.json holds, per row, the public source that lists the endpoint (the merchant's own docs or a public x402 discovery listing), the paid URL if one is public, the networks it advertises, and a status. The check is passive and read-only: tools/merchant_rows.py --run <slug> first reads the origin's robots.txt and the row's recorded terms-of-service URL, and stops with 'not run: robots or terms' if automated access to that path is disallowed; otherwise it runs `x402conf resource --min-interval 5 --max-requests 3` on the paid URL, which sends one unpaid GET and grades the 402 challenge (P1-P7, and P9 when the bazaar extension is present) against the spec. It never sends a payment header, never signs, never POSTs, never calls /verify, /settle or /supported on any host, and never pays. A row is run only on a testnet or devnet endpoint the merchant offers publicly; where only mainnet is offered the row is recorded as live-not-run ('mainnet only, not run') and nothing is fetched; where there is no public paid URL (for example a facilitator or SDK vendor with no paid resource of its own) the row is out-of-reach with that reason. Requests to any one host are at least 5 s apart. Rows use the XC-93 format: Environment, N/M, failed count only, date and evidence link, rerun and missing-check links. The coverage ledger (XC-54) gains a merchants section from the same file.

criteria.statement: docs/merchants.json has exactly one row for each of the 13 slugs, each with a public source URL, an Environment of testnet, live-not-run or out-of-reach, and a reason for the last two
Every testnet row links committed evidence/merchants/<slug>/run.json and SHA256SUMS from x402conf resource, graded on testnet or devnet CAIP-2 ids only, with P1-P7 results and N/M computed from them

Every committed merchant run is passive: its pacing log shows only GET requests (robots.txt and the paid URL), at most 3 per host, at least 5 s apart, none to a /verify, /settle or /supported path, and none carrying a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT header

The checker and runner reject or refuse: a run with a POST, a payment header, a facilitator path, two requests under 5 s apart, more than 3 requests to a host, a mainnet-only row that has a run, a run whose robots.txt disallows the path, and a row without a public source
docs/MATRIX.md has a merchant table generated from docs/merchants.json, in the XC-93 row format, with a row for each of the 13 slugs
The coverage ledger has a merchants section with the same 13 rows, each linking evidence or carrying its out-of-reach or mainnet-only reason

verifier.cmd: python3 tools/coverage_ledger.py --check && python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('docs/coverage-ledger.json'));m=d.get('merchants',[]);print(len(m));sys.exit(0 if len(m)>=13 and all(x.get('evidence') or x.get('reason') for x in m) else 1)"

tasks.description: One row format for every table in docs/MATRIX.md (facilitator matrix, self-hosted columns, implementation matrix and the merchant rows of XC-92), generated by tools/compat_matrix.py from docs/matrix-rows.json and committed evidence, never typed by hand. Every row has: Environment, one of testnet (run against a public testnet or devnet endpoint), devnet (run locally from source or fixtures, on loopback, with testnet or devnet ids), live-not-run (mainnet only, not exercised) or out-of-reach (hosted only, or nothing public to run against), with a short reason for the last two; the version or commit tested; checks passed out of checks run (for example 42/48), and the failed count; the last run date linking the committed run.json and its SHA256SUMS; a 'rerun / get listed' link; and a 'missing check?' link. Failed checks appear as a count only: no check names, no narrative, in the table. There is no overall score, rank, ordering by result, badge or 'certified' wording anywhere in the matrix. The 'rerun / get listed' link goes to a section of docs/MATRIX.md that gives the self-serve path: a vendor opens a PR that adds or updates its row with a run.json produced by the suite against its own testnet endpoint or its own loopback build, and CI regenerates the row from that evidence (or opens the add-facilitator issue form). The 'missing check?' link goes to the check-proposal section of GOVERNANCE.md (XC-53) and the check-proposal issue form. The XC-76 scoreboard can read the same fields; this task does not change its rules.

criteria.statement: Every row of every table in docs/MATRIX.md has an Environment cell whose value is exactly one of testnet, devnet, live-not-run or out-of-reach, and every live-not-run or out-of-reach row has a non-empty reason

Every row that has been run shows checks passed out of checks run as N/M, the failed count, the version or commit tested, and a last-run date that links a committed run.json whose SHA256SUMS verifies; N, M and the failed count are computed from that run.json

The checker rejects a hand-edited N/M, an Environment value outside the four, a run row without evidence or pin, a row that names a failed check or carries free text in the failed cell, and a live-not-run row that links a run
docs/MATRIX.md has no overall score, rank, ranking or 'certified' wording

Every row has a 'rerun / get listed' link to the self-serve section of docs/MATRIX.md, and that section says a vendor can open a PR with a run.json from the suite against its own testnet endpoint or its own loopback build, or open the add-facilitator issue form

verifier.cmd: python3 tools/compat_matrix.py --check --links rerun && grep -Eq '^#+ .*([Gg]et listed|[Rr]erun)' docs/MATRIX.md && grep -q 'add-facilitator' docs/MATRIX.md

criteria.statement: Every row has a 'missing check?' link to the check-proposal section of GOVERNANCE.md, and GOVERNANCE.md links the check-proposal issue form

verifier.cmd: python3 tools/compat_matrix.py --check --links missing-check && grep -Eq '^#+ .*[Pp]ropos(e|ing|al).*check' GOVERNANCE.md && grep -q 'check-proposal' GOVERNANCE.md
